QuestInfo.name: Spy on the Zenumist
QuestInfo.0: Alcadno Society leader Maed has a request for you.
QuestInfo.1: Maed the Alcadno Society leader want to know what the Zenumist are up to and asks you to bring the experiment material hidden in #b#MDmirrorD_326_0_##k.
QuestInfo.2: You brought the experiement material from #MDmirrorD_326_0_# for Alcadno Society leader Maed.

0.0: The Zenumist condemns us for research they believe goes against the laws of nature. But if you follow their thought processes, you wouldn't have alchemy or science. Their logic is too restrictive.
0.1: I am sure Carson is not releasing his research results because they are too embarrassing for his organization. I already know how poor his research is...but I want to see it with my own eyes. Will you help me?

yes.0: Go immediately to #b#MDmirrorD_326_0_##k and bring back the research subject. I don't need the small stuff. Just bring back the thing that #rlooks most important#k. And if you are caught, we don't know each other. You understand, yes?

no.0: Wait... Are you a supporter of the Zenumists?

1.0: Did you bring back the Zenumist research subjects?

yes.0: Are you sure this came out of the Zenumist research facility? I...can't believe the Zenumist have made so much progress in life alchemy...

default.0: I am not asking you to steal... I am asking you to give me a glimpse of their research progress.
